thread:
Alyssa (Sec): Quick heads-up: we're deprecating repo-level long-lived SSH deploy keys. Enforcement starts 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC. Please migrate to Vault-signed SSH certs or OIDC flows for CI.

sec-bot: Org scan 2026-03-11 03:05 UTC -> 58 repos detected with SSH keys in secrets/vars. Report: https://go/internal/ssh-secrets-scan

Carlos (Infra): For on-prem runners we need a clear agent path.

Alyssa (Sec): Use redwood/vault-ssh-init image for runners (fetches short-lived certs via instance identity). For Actions/GitLab CI use the snippet in the migration doc to request a signed cert at job runtime.

Priya (CI): Will pipelines fail loudly at enforcement?

Alyssa (Sec): Yesthey'll get "secret access denied" or "key revoked" errors. We provide a 48h emergency exception via https://go/internal/sec-exceptions (infra oncall + sec lead approval).

Emily (SRE): Is there an automated helper for creating PRs?

sec-bot: Tool: tools/ssh_secret_rewrite.py --repo <org/repo> will detect legacy secrets, add a workflow change branch, and open a PR for review. It does not auto-merge.

Carlos (Infra): I'll run the tool on critical services and post PRs here.

Alyssa (Sec): Prioritize deploy-heavy repos and control-plane services. Post blockers in #eng-platform or DM me. We'll revoke any remaining keys one week after enforcement and publish a short summary of issues encountered. :lock:
